card.name: "non" before biologic or steroidal drugs
card.fires_on: The word "non" (sometimes "low" or "chronic") right after "with", "or other" or "and/or" when a co-used drug class is being named. It comes just before a hyphen or "steroidal"/"biologic".

modes.label: non before biologic/steroidal
modes.description: "non" begins a drug class such as non-biologic DMARDs or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

modes.description: Words like "low" or "chronic" or "receiving" come after a linking phrase and lead into a drug or dose term.

card.writes: It seems to prepare a hyphenated or compound drug-class term, but the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on "non" when a text lists other drugs taken together, as in non-biologic or nonsteroidal drugs.
